scope: Supersonic Mode through The Savior Has Come
evidence_summary: Repository canonical skill records, transformation research, maintained PQ reward data, mentor evidence, Free Update provenance, and existing conflict notes were revalidated. Character-only, built-in-action, mentor, tournament, PQ, and Future Saga acquisition semantics were preserved.
evidence_limits: Supreme Fury retains conflicting reward-list versus explicit drop-condition presentation; the canonical Ultimate Finish flag follows the explicit drop-condition evidence.
Teleporting Vanishing Ball has no established UF-only gate in current maintained reward evidence.
The Power to Overcome retains conflicting measurements instead of collapsing them into false precision.
Detailed combat mechanics remain intentionally deferred for mentor skills where stronger evidence is not yet present.
